what.title: One platform for heat pump management
what.description: Go be Smart connects to your heat pumps and turns live data into action. Reduce the cost of heat pump maintenance and ownership. Make heat pumps work for everyone.

statement.lead: The energy transition runs on heat pumps.
statement.middle: But the expertise to run them well is scarce. Energy gets wasted and the cost of maintenance and ownership explodes.

pricing.title: Work with us the way that fits
pricing.description: Use it as a platform, integrate it over API, or let us handle your heat pumps entirely. Every engagement is tailored, talk to us for a quote.

api.name: API services
api.description: Plug our intelligence into your own systems and products over API: automated commissioning, problem diagnosis, smart control, agentic support, and product intelligence. You pay only for the modules you use.

platform.name: Platform
platform.description: Heat pump asset management for your whole portfolio: live status, maintenance planning, and reporting, extended with the custom features your workflow needs.

fullService.name: Full service
fullService.description: We manage the heat pumps in your portfolio for you: commissioning, monitoring, and support, handled end-to-end by our team.

meta.title: Product | Go be Smart
meta.description: From first startup to years of quiet operation: automated commissioning, problem detection and maintenance management, smart control, and agentic support in one platform.

hero.title: From first startup to years of quiet operation
hero.description: One platform for every heat pump in your fleet or product line: commission remotely, watch performance live, and let every device respond intelligently to the energy system around it.

commissioning.title: Automated commissioning
commissioning.description: Start up and tune heat pumps remotely, and keep tuning them as seasons and usage change. No second site visit to get the settings right.

monitoring.title: Problem detection & maintenance
monitoring.description: Live performance data across your whole fleet, problems detected before anyone notices, and maintenance turned into a plan: when to go where, what to bring, and what to do.
bullets: Maintenance planning: right visit, right parts, first-time fix

control.title: Smart control
control.description: Steer heat pumps on energy prices, capacity tariffs, and solar self-use — lower bills for residents, less stress on the grid.

ai.title: Agentic support
ai.description: AI agents grounded in the live data of the exact device in front of you: installation and diagnosis support for service teams, and product intelligence for the teams behind the product.

meta.title: About | Go be Smart
meta.description: We're building the intelligence that unlocks the full potential of heat pumps. Meet the team in Utrecht.

mission.title: Unlocking the full potential of heat pumps
mission.description: The energy transition runs on heat pumps, but only if they perform. We started Go be Smart because too many heat pumps are installed, switched on, and never looked at again. We build the intelligence that keeps them performing for years, and keeps maintaining them affordable.

descriptions.keje: Our data & ML expert. He prefers to spend his time building IoT solutions. You can wake up Keje in the middle of the night to talk about heat pumps.
descriptions.charlie: Versed in marketing and sales, this innovation expert now wants to build real solutions contributing to a more sustainable energy system.
descriptions.age: Solving abstract problems is what makes Age tick. After his PhD in theoretical biophysics, he has now immersed himself in the world of modern software.
